description: Create Tax Code for a given company

invoice_tax_application.description: Tax Code Invoice Tax Application. GROSS is accepted only when the company is on the new tax experience. Omit or send NET for the legacy experience.

display_in_budget.description: Whether the tax code should be displayed in budget views

is_group.description: Whether this tax code is a group. A group tax code aggregates multiple component tax codes. Requires the `financials.tax.enable_tax_groups` feature flag to be enabled.

component_tax_code_ids.description: IDs of the component tax codes that make up this group. Only valid when `is_group` is `true`. Requires the `financials.tax.enable_tax_groups` feature flag to be enabled.
